data.narrative:
Seasats is a Series A frontier-tech company in the Ocean & Maritime sector, led by Mike Flanigan (CEO) alongside co-founders Dan Flanigan, Dylan Rodriguez (CTO), and Max Kramers. The company has raised approximately $40M to date. The comparable universe consists of two private peers (Bedrock Ocean, Havoc AI) and no public trading comps in the ocean tech space.

The stage-progression method, the applicable triangulation approach given data constraints, uses the $40M total raised as a proxy for entry valuation and applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage progression. This yields an implied valuation of $80M. The method reflects normalized step-up expectations in frontier tech, though it relies on the assumption that dry powder and deployment velocity align with median cohort patterns.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $68M (low) to $92M (high), with a median point estimate of $80M. Key uncertainties include the absence of public market comparables in ocean technology, which limits benchmarking of revenue multiples or unit economics against seasoned businesses. With only two private peers in the comp set, sectoral validation remains constrained. The valuation is therefore most reliable as a stage-appropriate range rather than a point estimate; material revision would likely follow clarity on revenue trajectory, capital efficiency, and sector-specific risk factors not captured in the stage-progression method alone.
